As principal, I need to review and approve the independent-study plan before the student can be enrolled. Before I can approve it, I need to make sure it meets district policy, which requires the plan to document all course-specific requirements and provide a recurring meeting time that the student can reliably attend. I'd like to discuss the details and make sure we have everything in order. What can each of you share with me about this plan?
